_about: Digit ground truth for the OCR gate (ADR-019). Read off the rasterised gazette pages BY EYE on 2026-09-09, not produced by any OCR engine — an engine cannot be its own ruler.
_source: data/raw/gazette-28-mukarrar-h-2020-07-15.pdf, sha256 deb05826…, rasterised with pdfimages at 1339x1916.
_why_these_pages: p07 carries `المادة (١٢)`, a cross-reference inside running prose — the hardest and most consequential digit on the page. p28 carries two lists of article numbers (`٣٦، ٣٧، …`), where an engine that swallows the Arabic comma fuses two article numbers into one. p10 carries article 7, whose wording («اثنتين وسبعين ساعة», «بموافاة المركز») is what the corpus-fidelity check turns on — it was added on 2026-09-09 after reading the page image, and before scoring any engine on it. Between them they cover every way a digit appears in this document: page header, article header, in-prose reference, and comma-separated list.
_header_note: The running header is identical on all 29 pages: «الجريدة الرسمية - العدد ٢٨ مكرر (ه) فى ١٥ يولية سنة ٢٠٢٠». The printed page label is the image index + 1.

critical.١٢: المادة (١٢) — an in-prose cross-reference. easyocr read it as ١٢١.

critical.٣٦: first number in the cross-reference list — easyocr swallowed the Arabic comma and read ٣٦، as ٣٦١.

critical.٧: مادة (٧) — the article the whole fidelity finding rests on.
